brief.audience: Top creator with a team, daily output and deadline pressure

slides.headline: Your limit is not your talent.
Every model. Room to iterate.
slides.qualification: 60+ video and 35+ image models. Four USD price examples retained from the source: MiniMax H3, Veo 3.1 Fast, GPT Image 2 and ElevenLabs Turbo. Not live quotes; provider configuration and model availability vary.

slides.headline: One key. Mix any model.
slides.qualification: A conceptual shared workspace, not measured live rendering progress. Provider failover depends on compatible availability; limits still apply.

slides.headline: Your team. One bill. Total control.
slides.qualification: Antseed Gateway manages per-editor/project keys, budgets, caps and usage. Gateway docs button links to the existing official Gateway documentation.

slides.headline: The network, in numbers.
slides.qualification: Historical snapshot supplied by the user, not a fresh data fetch. Active-user window is unspecified. AntSeedStats attribution and CC BY 4.0 retained.

slides.headline: Your shot. Live. Compare the result and bill.
slides.qualification: Live-shot invitation and three next steps stay primary. A small rewards card mentions eligible usage, referrals and agreed launch/featured support, subject to program terms and eligibility.

editorial_decisions: Added an Antseed creator home slide based on the live vision-deck cover.
Problem is the title of the first content slide. Multiple subscriptions, bills and logins replace Eight. A single-line Antseed description is included.
The model offer returns to three illustrated Video/Image/Voice cards. Four price examples are shown; the full eight-row table is intentionally omitted at the user’s request.

The mixed-model workflow joins the 2am technical slide. One shared key fans out to five unnumbered model lanes with aligned progress bars; no sequential arrows, step numbers or simultaneous/parallel claim. The slide page numeral is also omitted.
Deck remains seven slides after adding the cover and combining the workflow.
35+ image models retained from the user correction.
All PDF, offline HTML, source ZIP and Vercel exports are regenerated together.
The team-operations slide explicitly attributes its controls to Antseed Gateway and adds a Gateway docs button.
AntSeedStats is the second-last slide, showing the four supplied historical values and the 13 November 2026 snapshot date. No current retrieval date or fresh live values are claimed.
The standalone rewards slide is replaced by the stats page; rewards move into a modest supporting card on the final live-shot/next-action slide. The deck remains seven slides.
